items: 【Product Includes】You will receive 16 pieces of leather furniture cat scratch protectors, each measuring 17×11.8 inches. You can freely cut them to fit the size of your furniture surfaces.

【Specially Designed for Leather】Our cat couch protector features a newly upgraded adhesive back specifically designed for leather furniture. It offers strong adhesion and is easy to peel off, ensuring it won't damage the leather surface or leave any residue, preserving the original appearance of your leather.

【Sturdy and Durable】It is made from thick PVC material, offering high toughness and enhanced sturdiness to protect your furniture from cat scratches for a longer time. It also features excellent fold rebound elasticity and strong adhesion, allowing it to conform better to the furniture surface and provide superior protection.

【Practical and Aesthetically Pleasing】This cat furniture protector is completely transparent, blending perfectly with the furniture surface without damaging its original appearance and decorative effect. It does not require screw fixation, avoiding the risk of pets ingesting screws and preventing damage to the furniture due to holes, making your home life more secure.

【Easy to Use】Installing our cat scratch protectors is a simple process. First, choose the area to be protected and wipe the surface clean. Then, cut the size as needed (optional). Next, peel off the self-adhesive pad, and finally, stick the adhesive side onto the furniture surface. You can use it on leather sofas, beds, chairs, cabinets, and other furniture that needs protection.
